subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the Matrix QA ownership cleanup land after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 with the qa-matrix package and dependency-graph removal approved on the refreshed exact head?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but stack ordering, removal of a workspace package, and repository dependency authorization require an eligible human to accept the compatibility and operational transition.

options.title: Refresh and land the stack
options.body: Merge the predecessor, rebase this PR cleanly, rerun exact-head checks, approve the intentional dependency removal, and land the cleanup.

options.title: Pause the package removal
options.body: Keep the temporary qa-matrix owner until the predecessor workflow and all source-checkout consumers are stable on main.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land the stack
recommendation.body: Merge the predecessor, rebase this PR cleanly, rerun exact-head checks, approve the intentional dependency removal, and land the cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: They have current-main QA Lab ownership history and direct context for the full four-PR migration sequence.
